newsitem.title: USA: Dynamic Homes to manage Ely, Minn. resort.
newsitem.headline: Dynamic Homes to manage Ely, Minn. resort.

text.p: Dynamic Homes Inc said Wednesday it assumed responsibility for managing and operating its Ely, Minn. resort by acquiring the management interest of its previous property management firm.

The company, through a wholly owned subsidiary, Shagawa Resort Inc, acquired the Holiday Inn Sunspree Motel in Ely in September 1995 as part of a financial restructuring package stemming from financial difficulties of the resort's former owners.

At that time, the company entered into a property management agreement with the former owners, who were granted an option through December 15, 1997 to buy the 61-room motel. Through a negotiated settlement, the net purchase price of the management interest was $53,000. The company also forgave $64,000 owed Shagawa Resort by the property management firm.
